title: Quevedo Announces El Baifo Tour 2027 With Video Game Inspired by Las Palmas de Gran Canaria in Spain
summary: Fans will need to unlock clues and exclusive content to discover the tour dates of the trek.
contentText:
Quevedo has surprised his fans by dropping the first hints about El Baifo Tour, his upcoming trek across Spain, through an Instagram Story with a link that directs users to a video game designed to progressively reveal details. The initiative comes less than two months after the release of his third studio album, El Baifo .

Upon accessing the website, users will find a video game featuring a baifo (a young goat, a symbol of the Canary Islands) exploring settings inspired by Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, a city in Spain that plays a central role in the visual universe of the project.

The game is reminiscent of Google’s popular dinosaur that appears when there is no internet connection. Alongside the game, the platform displays a world map under the title “Tour 2027,” which currently only references “Península” (the Iberian Peninsula) along with the message “Coming Soon.”

It quickly became a hot topic among the artist’s fans, who started sharing scores, theories and possible destinations on social media just hours after its publication. According to data shared by the artist’s team with Billboard , the video game recorded more than 825,000 sessions and nearly 97,000 unique players during the first 24 hours. For now, Quevedo is keeping the dates and cities for El Baifo Tour under wraps.

Meanwhile, El Baifo continues to dominate the charts in Spain. This week, Quevedo holds four of the top 10 spots on Billboard ’s Spain Songs ranking, led by “La Graciosa” featuring Elvis Crespo at No. 1, “Al Golpito” at No. 2, “Ni Borracho” at No. 6 and “El Baifo” at No. 10. The album’s success underscores the momentum the artist is enjoying and sets the stage for a tour that’s already generating excitement among his fans.
